name: WCORR-WEB-003: Server-side exploitation indicator followed by PHP file creation
description: This rule uses a narrower selection of web exploitation indicators followed by PHP file creation.
query:
sequence by agent.id.keyword with maxspan=10m
  [any where rule.id.keyword in
    ("31106", "31110", "31166", "31168")]
  [any where rule.id.keyword == "554"
    and syscheck.event.keyword == "added"
    and syscheck.path.keyword like
      "/var/lib/docker/volumes/web_wp_data/_data/wp-content/uploads/*.php"]
author: Wazuh EQL Correlation
false_positives: Investigative correlation only: HTTP 200 does not prove exploitation. FIM detection time may differ from creation time, and legitimate deployments may match.
setup: Collect the narrower exploitation rule IDs and added-file FIM at the exact WordPress Docker volume path.
